brief: Every figure read from the document at url (page = PDF page index). value is a string exactly as printed, in unit as printed. kind: outturn | plan | revised plan. scope: whole body | children's line | related (not children-specific). Never summed, apportioned or converted. check: extraction = column assignment uncertain, do not use; conflict = another source or a restatement disagrees, both kept.

conventions: page = 1-based PDF page index, not the printed page number.

Main Estimates figures are the Net Resources column (col 7, from 2022-23) or the Net Total resources column (col 6, 2019-20 to 2021-22 format) of Part II Subhead detail, unless the note says CAPITAL. Each row was extracted by word coordinates and its internal arithmetic (gross + income = net; admin + programme = total) was checked; all rows reconciled.
Budget-document labels are built as: table title - row label - column heading, each part verbatim from the source, joined with ' - '.
Main Estimates were taken from finance-ni.gov.uk copies; the QUB NIOPA repository (libdeposit.qub.ac.uk) did not resolve from this machine.
Non ring-fenced and ring-fenced Resource DEL are recorded separately and never summed.

doh.pageConvention: 'page' is the 1-based page index of the PDF file, which often differs from the page number printed on the page. null for HTML pages and spreadsheets.
